name: edu-desk
description: School management platform: Next.js frontend (apps/web) + Express backend (apps/backend)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix apps/backend && npm install --prefix apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix apps/backend && npm run build --prefix apps/web
scripts.test: npm test --prefix apps/backend && npm test --prefix apps/web
scripts.start:local: npm run migrate:up && npm run dev
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix apps/backend && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix apps/backend && npm run lint --prefix apps/web
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix --prefix apps/backend && npm run lint:fix --prefix apps/web
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --prefix apps/backend && npm run test:coverage --prefix apps/web
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage
